# teamLab

> > teamLab is a Japanese art collective creating immersive digital art installations that explore the relationship between humans, nature, and technology through interactive, borderless experiences.

teamLab operates permanent museums and exhibitions worldwide, including teamLab Borderless Jeddah, teamLab Planets Tokyo, and installations at major institutions like the National Gallery of Victoria and Museum of Contemporary Art Los Angeles. Their works combine light sculptures, interactive installations, and environmental continuity philosophy to create transformative art experiences.

## Key Topics

- Interactive digital installations
- Immersive art experiences
- Borderless art museums
- Light sculpture installations
- Dissipative Figures series
- Environmental continuity philosophy
- Permanent exhibitions worldwide
- teamLab Planets Tokyo
- teamLab Borderless Jeddah
- Resonating lamps and tea houses
- Drawing-to-life installations
- Flow and movement visualizations
- Nature-inspired digital art
- Collaborative art collective
- Museum partnerships globally

## Permanent Museums & Major Exhibitions

- [teamLab Borderless Jeddah](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/e/jeddah): Permanent borderless digital art museum in Jeddah Historic District
- [Figge Art Museum](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/e/figgeartmuseum): Permanent exhibition at Figge Art Museum, Iowa featuring water particles
- [Galaxy & チームラボ：連続する軌跡](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/e/continuoustrajectories): Continuous Trajectories exhibition at Galaxy Harajuku, Tokyo 2025
- [Melbourne Art Fair](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/e/melbourneartfair): teamLab exhibition at Melbourne Art Fair 2026 featuring Darkness artwork

## Light Sculpture & Dissipative Figures

- [Dissipative Figures – 1000 Birds, Light in Dark (Eight)](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/w/dissipative-birds-light-eight): Dissipative Figures artwork visualizing bird flocks through energy flow
- [Dissipative Figures - 1000 Birds, Light in Dark (Four)](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/w/dissipative-birds-light-four): Dissipative Figures installation at Beit Zenel, Jeddah 2024
- [Labyrinth of Memory](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/labyrinth-asm): Light Sculpture Flow installation at teamLab Future World Singapore
- [覚醒 / Awakening](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/awakening-jeddah): Light Sculpture Flow series in asymmetric mirror space at Jeddah
- [変容する連続体 / Morphing Continuum](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/w/morphingcontinuum): Immersive light sculpture installation at teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi

## Interactive & Immersive Installations

- [Black Waves: Flowing Beyond Borders](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/w/blackwaves-beyondborders): Borderless wave installation at Mori Building Digital Art Museum
- [こびとが住まう奏でる壁 / A Musical Wall where Little People Live](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/littlepeople-wall-kyoto): Interactive musical wall with little people at teamLab Kyoto
- [スケッチ環世界 / Sketch Umwelt World](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/sketchumwelt-planets): Drawing-to-life installation exploring animal perception at teamLab Planets
- [Forest of Flow and Light](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/forest-flow-light-kyoto): Interactive forest installation with dancing pillars at teamLab Kyoto
- [風と雨と太陽の草原 / Field of Wind, Rain and Sun](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/field-wind-rain-sun-field): Interactive grassland installation with responsive soundscapes in Osaka

## Tea House & Resonating Experiences

- [EN TEA HOUSE - 応灯楼](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/enteahouse-otoro): Tea house installation with resonating lamps at Mifuneyama Rakuen
- [共鳴する茶と酒 - 動的定常色 / Tea and Sake in Spontaneous Order](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/ew/tea-spontaneousorder-planets): Interactive tea/sake installation with resonating lamps and dynamic color

## Nature & Environmental Works

- [太陽の円相 / Enso of the Sun](https://www.teamlab.art/jp/w/enso-sunlight): Rainbow circle installation appearing at solar noon in Higashi-Osaka
